test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the Magento admin sales order page at 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/'. Since the execution summary shows 30 steps all on the same order management page, I've extracted common test values for Magento admin authentication and order search parameters. The username/password are default Magento admin credentials, and the other parameters represent typical values used for searching/filtering orders in a Magento admin panel.
